ruledOut: Treating the Webflow topic leaves as generic fallbacks: the copy probe shows their owner directories are deleted and the router does not reassign ownership.

label: Surface-first routing does not transfer deleted Webflow leaves to OpenCode; the router selects surface before intent.
The OpenCode §6 map is narrower than the stack-agnostic intent set; only existing shared universal guidance clearly serves DEBUGGING and IMPLEMENTATION after deletion.
The prepared copy loses Webflow and Obsidian leaves; the post-delete projection retains only files whose owners survive.
R6 should add only existing OpenCode workflow leaves that are not already mapped, and leave PERFORMANCE, DEPLOYMENT, and ACCESSIBILITY to a user-owned surface unless suitable shared content exists.
